## Purpose

Describe the user problem and the outcome this capability owns.

## User flow

List the normal flow and the points where the user sees, approves, corrects, or cancels work.

## Responsibilities

- What this capability must do.
- What it must not do.

## Inputs and outputs

Document typed inputs, outputs, stored records, emitted events, and provenance requirements.

## States and failure handling

## Policy, security, and privacy

Document authorization, approvals, sensitive data, retention, redaction, and untrusted-input boundaries.

## Dependencies

Link related feature docs and architecture decisions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State measurable behavior.
- [ ] Include unhappy-path behavior.

## Tests and evaluations

- Record unresolved decisions without silently choosing them in code.
